title: Good Growth — one-screen 3D "disc" carousel
note: Electric violet with halftone dots, pixel/techno display type, wireframe orbits. The page never scrolls: each wheel tick spins to the next project object and swaps the big title. An "Insert disc" gate with sound, then a boot sequence where G O O D spreads to the edges while a counter runs and 3D icons orbit in. three.js + GSAP + Web Audio.
